infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Graphology uses the camera to photograph your handwriting so we can analyze traits like slant, pressure, baseline, and letter formation. For example, write a short phrase on paper and Graphology will identify your dominant writing personality.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Graphology can analyze an existing handwriting sample from your photo library. For example, choose a photo of a handwritten letter or note and Graphology will interpret the slant, pressure, and letter formation.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Graphology to access your photos to analyze handwriting samples.
